correctness.rationale: Condition on the unordered first-i value set S_i. The original prefix record R_i has conditional probability 1/i independent of S_i. For i<j, either j is in the prefix and Q_j is impossible, or Q_j depends on the suffix ordering only; inversion symmetry handles i>j. For i=j the only conditional covariance occurs when S_i={1,...,i}, of probability 1/binom(n,i), on which both indicators equal 1 exactly when pi(i)=i; the conditional variance is (i-1)/i². This proves diagonal entry (i-1)/(i² binom(n,i)), zero off-diagonal, aggregate covariance and correlation. Independently exhaustively checked all n² joint equations over every permutation for n=2 through 7; these finite tests corroborate, not replace, the all-n conditional proof.
